# ADG Monitor dashboard clarity changes

This branch changes dashboard presentation only. It does not alter production site content or deployment configuration.

- Google URL Inspection counts are labelled as a rolling 24-hour checked sample, rather than implying a site-wide Search Console total.
- Thin-page word-count flags are displayed as content advisories rather than hard red failures when they are the only issue shown on a card.
- Action buttons visibly switch to the selected task when clicked.
- A spinner and status message show while the selected monitor task is running.
